specs.description: `AbstractPersistenceFactory.java` — Abstract persistence factory. Called from `CQLMappedEntityValueConverter.convert`, and possibly from places the call graph cannot see. At run time it reaches 6 other parts of the project. `AbstractPersistenceFactory` carries `MAPPED_ENTITY_VALUE_SEPARATOR`, `MAPPED_VALUE_FORMAT`, `COLLECTION_VALUE_SEPARATOR`, `log`, `typeConverters`, `keyspaceDefinitions`, `entities`, `defaultConsistencyLevel` and 20 more. `getKey` has 4 failure conditions and 2 of them are stated here, `loadMappedCollection` has 3 failure conditions and 1 of them is stated here and `loadMappedEntity` has 3 failure conditions and 1 of them is stated here — the rest are in the findings in Predictable Code (the Control Center, or your editor). REFUTED: “`init` throws `IllegalStateException` unless the value of `getDefaultKeySpace`(the `AbstractPersistenceFactory`) is not null.” 4 requirements: 1 violated, 3 verified. 21 stated failures.
